ID-city-of-rocks-california-trail.alt: City of Rocks, near the Raft River in Idaho.
ID-city-of-rocks-california-trail.caption: City of Rocks, near the Raft River in Idaho.
ID-city-of-rocks-california-trail.credit: Timothy H. O’Sullivan, Geological Exploration of the Fortieth Parallel, Library of Congress
ID-city-of-rocks-california-trail.groundReview: Dossier cites LOC 2006685033, the exact print. The albumen mount shows the granite outcrops described in the dossier’s photo record.

ID-craters-of-the-moon.alt: Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve, Idaho.
ID-craters-of-the-moon.caption: Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve, Idaho.
ID-craters-of-the-moon.groundReview: The dossier names NPGallery asset ac5d1d86-71ee-449b-91d2-9e640883c519. The cinder butte rises behind dark lava and scattered trees in the park landscape.

ID-idaho-city.caption: Idaho City from the air.
ID-idaho-city.credit: Capt. A. W. Stevens, U.S. Army Air Corps, University of Idaho Library
ID-idaho-city.groundReview: The dossier cites archivalidaho357 and Army27. The Army Air Corps aerial shows the street grid beside the worked creek flats described by the town dossier.

ID-idaho-city.caption: Main Street and its wooden boardwalk in Idaho City.
ID-idaho-city.alt: Main Street and its wooden boardwalk in Idaho City.
ID-idaho-city.groundReview: The source identifies the wooden boardwalk on Main Street in Idaho City. The sidewalk is a raised plank boardwalk alongside the historic street frontage.

ID-three-island-crossing.alt: Three Island Crossing overlook and trail ruts at Glenns Ferry on the Oregon National Historic Trail.
ID-three-island-crossing.caption: Three Island Crossing overlook and trail ruts at Glenns Ferry on the Oregon National Historic Trail.
ID-three-island-crossing.groundReview: NPS identifies the Three Island Crossing overlook and trail ruts at Glenns Ferry. The elevated view shows the Snake River wrapping around the low islands at the ford described in the dossier.

st-joe-st-maries.alt: The grave and memorial to firefighters killed in the Great Fire of 1910, Woodlawn Cemetery, St. Maries.
st-joe-st-maries.caption: The grave and memorial to firefighters killed in the Great Fire of 1910, Woodlawn Cemetery, St. Maries.
st-joe-st-maries.groundReview: The source names the 1910 firefighters’ grave and memorial at Woodlawn Cemetery. Small grave markers surround the central monument beneath the trees, matching the memorial described in the entry.

AZ-bisbee-deportation-reflection.alt: Miners board railroad cattle cars during the Bisbee deportation, July 12, 1917.
AZ-bisbee-deportation-reflection.caption: Miners board railroad cattle cars during the Bisbee deportation, July 12, 1917.
AZ-bisbee-deportation-reflection.credit: Photographer unidentified, published as a contemporary postcard
AZ-bisbee-deportation-reflection.groundReview: The source explicitly identifies the deportation of striking miners at Bisbee on July 12. The crowd and the line of railroad cattle cars show the expulsion described in the entry.

AZ-poston-reflection.alt: A woman receives a ration book before leaving Poston by train.
AZ-poston-reflection.caption: A woman receives a ration book before leaving Poston by train.
AZ-poston-reflection.credit: Hikaru Iwasaki, U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
AZ-poston-reflection.groundReview: The wartime caption identifies a person receiving a ration book at the Colorado River Relocation Center in Poston. The source identifies Poston, Arizona, the confinement ground named in the entry.

CO-amache-reflection.alt: The barracks at the Granada Relocation Center, also known as Amache.
CO-amache-reflection.caption: The barracks at the Granada Relocation Center, also known as Amache.
CO-amache-reflection.groundReview: The archive identifies the Granada Relocation Center, also called Amache. The repeated long barracks and open avenues show the wartime camp layout above ground.

ID-cottonwood-air-force-station.alt: Cottonwood Air Force Station on the ridge, around 1964.
ID-cottonwood-air-force-station.caption: Cottonwood Air Force Station on the ridge, around 1964.
ID-cottonwood-air-force-station.groundReview: The dossier directly cites the Commons file FPS-24 and FPS-6A Radomes at Cottonwood AFS Idaho 1964. Two radomes are visible along the ridge, matching the radar installation described in the dossier.

lewiston-depot.caption: The Lewiston Depot at Thirteenth and Main streets.
lewiston-depot.alt: The Lewiston Depot at Thirteenth and Main streets.
lewiston-depot.groundReview: The source identifies the surviving 1909 Lewiston Depot. The photographer and dossier both specify 13th and Main streets in Lewiston.

ID-boise-uberuaga-boardinghouse.alt: The Cyrus Jacobs House in Boise.
ID-boise-uberuaga-boardinghouse.caption: The Cyrus Jacobs House in Boise.
ID-boise-uberuaga-boardinghouse.groundReview: The source names the Cyrus Jacobs House, also known as the Jacobs–Uberuaga House. The front roofed porch, pitched roof and chimney agree with the Grove Street building described in the dossier.

ID-custer-county-jail-challis.alt: The stone walls of the Custer County Jail in Challis.
ID-custer-county-jail-challis.caption: The stone walls of the Custer County Jail in Challis.
ID-custer-county-jail-challis.groundReview: The file identifies the Custer County Jail structure. Coursed stone walls and narrow openings agree with the dossier’s surviving rhyolite shell.

ID-troy-hospital.alt: The former Troy Hospital on South Main Street.
ID-troy-hospital.caption: The former Troy Hospital on South Main Street.
ID-troy-hospital.groundReview: The source identifies the historic Troy Hospital built in 1905. The source and entry give 604 South Main Street, Troy, Idaho.

ID-idaho-state-capitol.alt: The Idaho State Capitol in Boise.
ID-idaho-state-capitol.caption: The Idaho State Capitol in Boise.
ID-idaho-state-capitol.groundReview: The source names the Idaho State Capitol building in Boise. The central dome rises above the symmetrical wings and columned main entrance of the capitol.

AR-walnut-ridge-rail-and-airfield-worker.alt: Walnut Ridge Army Airfield seen from the air in 1942.
AR-walnut-ridge-rail-and-airfield-worker.caption: Walnut Ridge Army Airfield seen from the air in 1942.
AR-walnut-ridge-rail-and-airfield-worker.groundReview: The source identifies Walnut Ridge Army Airfield in 1942. The aerial shows the intersecting runways and wartime field layout.

IA-elkader-keystone-bridge-builders.alt: Keystone Bridge in Elkader, with the Clayton County Courthouse beyond.
IA-elkader-keystone-bridge-builders.caption: Keystone Bridge in Elkader, with the Clayton County Courthouse beyond.
IA-elkader-keystone-bridge-builders.groundReview: The source explicitly identifies Keystone Bridge in Elkader. The large masonry arches cross the river with the courthouse beyond them.

IA-eldon-american-gothic-house.alt: The American Gothic House, also called the Dibble House, in Eldon.
IA-eldon-american-gothic-house.caption: The American Gothic House, also called the Dibble House, in Eldon.
IA-eldon-american-gothic-house.groundReview: The source identifies the American Gothic House, also called the Dibble House. The pointed upper window in the front gable matches the dossier’s identifying architectural feature.

KS-atchison-earhart-family-house.alt: Amelia Earhart’s birthplace on North Terrace in Atchison.
KS-atchison-earhart-family-house.caption: Amelia Earhart’s birthplace on North Terrace in Atchison.
KS-atchison-earhart-family-house.groundReview: The source identifies the house as Amelia Earhart’s birthplace. The item places it on North Terrace in Atchison, the street identified in the dossier.

AR-hot-springs-bathhouse-workers.alt: The Fordyce Bathhouse porch in Hot Springs.
AR-hot-springs-bathhouse-workers.caption: The Fordyce Bathhouse porch in Hot Springs.
AR-hot-springs-bathhouse-workers.groundReview: The source identifies the specific Fordyce Porch on Bathhouse Row. The broad awning and porch across the bathhouse frontage match the dossier’s street-side resource.

ID-bethany-deaconess-hospital-american-f.caption: Bethany Deaconess Hospital after its relocation to Pocatello Avenue in American Falls.
ID-bethany-deaconess-hospital-american-f.alt: Bethany Deaconess Hospital after its relocation to Pocatello Avenue in American Falls.
ID-bethany-deaconess-hospital-american-f.groundReview: The source names Bethany Deaconess Hospital in American Falls, Idaho. The long brick frontage, projecting portico and low gables agree with the dossier’s description of the moved hospital.

KS-hollenberg-station-household-work.alt: The Hollenberg Pony Express Station in Kansas.
KS-hollenberg-station-household-work.caption: The Hollenberg Pony Express Station in Kansas.
KS-hollenberg-station-household-work.groundReview: The source names Hollenberg Pony Express Station, Kansas. The long timber building with its pitched roof matches the surviving original-site ranch house described in the entry.

MS-manship-house-ornamental-painter.caption: Interior of the Manship House in Jackson, Mississippi.
MS-manship-house-ornamental-painter.alt: Interior of the Manship House in Jackson, Mississippi.
MS-manship-house-ornamental-painter.groundReview: The Highsmith item specifically identifies the Manship House in Jackson, Mississippi. The furnished room and decorative painted finish show the surviving cottage interior discussed in the dossier.

ID-teton-dam.credit: U.S. Department of the Interior, Bureau of Reclamation
ID-teton-dam.caption: Water pouring out of the reservoir of the Teton Dam in Idaho following its catastrophic failure on June 5, 1976.
ID-teton-dam.alt: Water pouring out of the reservoir of the Teton Dam in Idaho following its catastrophic failure on June 5, 1976.
ID-teton-dam.groundReview: The Bureau of Reclamation identifies water escaping Teton Dam as it failed on June 5, 1976. The photograph shows reservoir water pouring through the broken embankment in the documented event.

SD-mitchell-corn-palace-makers.alt: The Corn Palace in Mitchell, South Dakota.
SD-mitchell-corn-palace-makers.caption: The Corn Palace in Mitchell, South Dakota.
SD-mitchell-corn-palace-makers.groundReview: The source names the Mitchell Corn Palace in South Dakota. The onion domes and decorated street facade identify the palace shown from the sidewalk.

TX-denison-eisenhower-birthplace-rail-to.alt: The Eisenhower Birthplace State Historic Site in Denison.
TX-denison-eisenhower-birthplace-rail-to.caption: The Eisenhower Birthplace State Historic Site in Denison.
TX-denison-eisenhower-birthplace-rail-to.groundReview: The item places the Eisenhower Birthplace State Historic Site in Denison, Texas. The photograph shows the white house with three front gables and its covered porch at the named birthplace.

TX-el-paso-union-depot-rail-work.caption: Union Depot in El Paso.
TX-el-paso-union-depot-rail-work.groundReview: The source names Union Depot in El Paso, Texas. The brick depot tower and adjoining street-side elevation match the features named in the entry.

TX-waco-suspension-bridge-cattle-work.alt: The suspension bridge over the Brazos River in Waco.
TX-waco-suspension-bridge-cattle-work.caption: The suspension bridge over the Brazos River in Waco.
TX-waco-suspension-bridge-cattle-work.groundReview: The repository identifies the suspension bridge across the Brazos in Waco. The masonry tower, suspension cables and trussed deck match the entry’s crossing.

WY-laramie-territorial-prison.alt: The main building of the Wyoming Territorial Penitentiary in Laramie.
WY-laramie-territorial-prison.caption: The main building of the Wyoming Territorial Penitentiary in Laramie.
WY-laramie-territorial-prison.groundReview: The item explicitly identifies the main penitentiary building at Laramie. The prison block and adjoining stockade are visible at the named territorial complex.

WY-sheridan-trail-end-staff.alt: The Kendrick Mansion at Trail End in Sheridan.
WY-sheridan-trail-end-staff.caption: The Kendrick Mansion at Trail End in Sheridan.
WY-sheridan-trail-end-staff.groundReview: The item identifies the Kendrick Mansion at Trail End. The source gives 400 Clarendon Avenue in Sheridan, the location recorded for Trail End.

MS-grand-gulf-military-park.alt: Remains of Fort Cobun at Grand Gulf Military State Park near Port Gibson.
MS-grand-gulf-military-park.caption: Remains of Fort Cobun at Grand Gulf Military State Park near Port Gibson.
MS-grand-gulf-military-park.groundReview: The photographer identifies the remains of Fort Cobun at Grand Gulf Military State Park. The surviving earth embankment is visible beneath the trees at the named position.

MO-watkins-woolen-mill-workers.caption: Watkins Woolen Mill located in Watkins Mill State Park.
MO-watkins-woolen-mill-workers.alt: Watkins Woolen Mill located in Watkins Mill State Park.
MO-watkins-woolen-mill-workers.groundReview: The file identifies Watkins Woolen Mill in Watkins Mill State Park. The tall brick mill with its chimney is visible beside the water at the site.

TX-johnson-city-lbj-boyhood-home.caption: Lyndon B. Johnson’s boyhood home in Johnson City, Texas.
TX-johnson-city-lbj-boyhood-home.alt: Lyndon B. Johnson’s boyhood home in Johnson City, Texas.
TX-johnson-city-lbj-boyhood-home.groundReview: The Highsmith item identifies the boyhood home in Johnson City, Texas. The street view shows the low frame house and its covered front porch described for this home.

TX-marfa-blackwell-school-witness.caption: Photograph of the Blackwell School in Marfa, Texas
TX-marfa-blackwell-school-witness.alt: Photograph of the Blackwell School in Marfa, Texas
TX-marfa-blackwell-school-witness.groundReview: The source names the Blackwell School in Marfa, Texas. The photograph shows the standing gable-front schoolhouse with its centered entrance.

TX-port-isabel-lighthouse-maritime-work.caption: Port Isabel Lighthouse in Port Isabel, Texas.
TX-port-isabel-lighthouse-maritime-work.alt: Port Isabel Lighthouse in Port Isabel, Texas.
TX-port-isabel-lighthouse-maritime-work.groundReview: The Highsmith record identifies Point Isabel Lighthouse at Port Isabel, Texas. The tapered white masonry tower and lantern match the surviving navigational structure.

spokane-fire-1889.caption: The Spokane Daily Chronicle’s makeshift office after the Great Fire of 1889.
spokane-fire-1889.alt: The Spokane Daily Chronicle’s makeshift office after the Great Fire of 1889.
spokane-fire-1889.groundReview: The source identifies the makeshift Chronicle office following Spokane’s Great Fire. The lettering Chronicle Office is visible on the tent occupied by the newspaper.

LA-the-myrtles-st-francisville.alt: A room at the Myrtles Plantation in St. Francisville.
LA-the-myrtles-st-francisville.caption: A room at the Myrtles Plantation in St. Francisville.
LA-the-myrtles-st-francisville.groundReview: The source and the dossier both identify National Register listing 78001439. The source identifies the building as Myrtles Plantation in St. Francisville, Louisiana.

MS-fort-massachusetts-ship-island.alt: Brick arches inside Fort Massachusetts on Ship Island.
MS-fort-massachusetts-ship-island.caption: Brick arches inside Fort Massachusetts on Ship Island.
MS-fort-massachusetts-ship-island.groundReview: The item and the dossier give National Register number 71000067. The photograph shows the series of brick-vaulted openings inside the fort described in the surviving-ground record.

bayhorse.caption: Mining structures at the Bayhorse townsite in Idaho.
bayhorse.alt: Mining structures at the Bayhorse townsite in Idaho.
bayhorse.groundReview: National Register listing 76000671 appears in the source and the dossier. Timber-sided mine structures climb the slope within the historic mining town shown in the district photograph.

cataldo-mission.credit: National Park Service, U.S. Department of the Interior
cataldo-mission.caption: The parish house yard east of the church at Cataldo Mission, August 30, 1975.
cataldo-mission.alt: The parish house yard east of the church at Cataldo Mission, August 30, 1975.
cataldo-mission.groundReview: The photograph and the mission dossier carry National Register number 66000312. The NPS photographic record locates this view in the parish house yard east of the church on August 30, 1975.
